svg.text: Separation of Concerns across Presentation, Controller, Service, Persistence, and Storage
Thymeleaf HTML5 Templates (student/, faculty/, admin/, fragments/, auth/) · Responsive layout.html · Bootstrap Theme CSS
Responsibilities: Display exam results, question mark breakdown, dispute forms, status badges, and aggregate analytics.
Spring MVC Controllers (@Controller) · SecurityFilterChain · Role-Based Routing · Form Binding & Flash Attributes
Responsibilities: Intercept HTTP requests, validate session identity, verify CSRF tokens, map request models, handle 403 access.
Spring Services (@Service, @Transactional) · Domain Services (RecheckRequestService, ReviewService, MarksService, AuditService)
Responsibilities: Verify recheck periods, duplicate check (ADR-003), compute total marks, apply score revisions, record audit logs.
Spring Data JPA Repositories · Hibernate 6 ORM · @EntityGraph Eager Fetching · Open-in-View Transaction Handling
Responsibilities: Abstract SQL generation, prevent N+1 queries, manage entity proxies, enforce unique constraint handling.
HikariCP Connection Pool · MySQL 8.0 InnoDB (Production) · H2 Database (In-Memory Testing) · Relational Constraints
Responsibilities: Provide ACID guarantees, primary/foreign key cascading, index lookups, and unique constraint enforcement.
